gpt.title: Turn the source material into clear conclusions
gpt.body: Summarize three key findings, separating validated evidence, open assumptions, and actions the team can take.

claude.title: Shape the findings into presentation copy
claude.body: Keep the evidence and caveats while rewriting the material into concise paragraphs that leadership can scan quickly.

gemini.title: Organize it as a slide narrative
gemini.body: Create a six-slide outline covering context, findings, implications, and next steps, with one takeaway per slide.

grok.title: Check gaps and opposing views
grok.body: Identify the two weakest claims, offer alternative explanations, and list the evidence that still needs verification.
